summary: Frontend E2E testing of Haul Yeah CRM new modules (jobs board, crew today, integrations card, tracking public page, review flow, clock-out review popup) — ALL requested user flows pass. Backend was pre-verified per main agent and not retested. Ran ~15 Playwright scenarios covering owner, crew and public (no-auth) surfaces plus regression on calculator and sales login.
action_items: (Data / non-blocking) Crew users Javante & Junior have NO phone numbers in the users collection. Because of this, the /today teammate row shows the name+position but no call/text icon links (frontend correctly hides ContactActions when phone is missing). The review request expected tel:/sms: links on the teammate row. Add crew phones via /crew or seed data so those icons appear.
critical_code_review_comments: CrewToday.jsx sendReview('email') sets window.location.href to mailto: BEFORE awaiting sendReviewRequestApi — in real browsers this can pause JS/leave the page and the log call may or may not fire (in this test env it did fire and a new review row appeared, so the observed behavior matches the spec). Consider awaiting the API call first, then triggering the mailto, for reliability across browsers.

IntegrationsCard.jsx notification URL is bootstrapped from the current backend URL — showed 'https://haul-yeah-staging.preview.emergentagent.com/api/webhooks/square' rather than the production 'haulyeahadmin.com' URL. Not a bug in preview, just note that in production it needs to be verified/overridden.

JobsBoard.jsx PayRow generates data-testid via label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]+/g,'-') — 'Deposit Paid (25%)' becomes 'pay-row-deposit-paid-' (trailing dash), 'Paid in Full' becomes 'pay-row-paid-in-full'. Test works, but a slugify util that trims trailing dashes would be cleaner.

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. During testing 1 extra review-request row was logged via the crew Email flow (INV-9042, email channel) — that is expected exercise of the flow and left in place; nothing else altered persistently (Junior/position and default_truck_pickup were both changed and restored to originals).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test job INV-9042 tracking token in DB: c7593650d9d34ec2b5e65cb06423036a. Public /track/{token} works without auth (route defined outside AuthGate in App.js). Bosses bubble is rendered by Layout.jsx and appears on ALL crew pages incl. /today, /clock, /jobs (verified). OpenPhone remains not connected — SMS/Text buttons produce a friendly 503 toast ('OpenPhone is not connected. Add the API key and number in Settings → Integrations.') which is the EXPECTED correct behavior. Do NOT put anything in the Square access token secret input (Square is live).
